prompt:
Research the officially documented limits of the Home Assistant Cloud (Nabu Casa) subscription: price per month and what is included. Cite the Nabu Casa page and quote it.

Output format (required):
For every claim you attribute to a source, write one line in exactly this form:
SOURCE: <full URL> | QUOTE: "<a sentence copied word-for-word from that page>" | CLAIM: <what you take it to show>
For anything the task asks about that you could not find a source for, write one line:
NO_SOURCE_FOUND: <what you could not find>
You can write normal explanation before or after these lines.

response.content:
Here is the documented information regarding the Home Assistant Cloud subscription limits and inclusions.

**Summary of Findings:**
The subscription is priced at **$6.50 USD per month** (or the equivalent in local currency). It is a feature-rich service that primarily enables secure remote access, voice assistant integration, and cloud backups. The documentation lists a comprehensive set of included features but does not specify hard limits (such as data caps or specific device counts) on the page provided.

**Source Citations:**

SOURCE: https://www.nabucasa.com/pricing/ | QUOTE: "The monthly subscription costs 6.50 USD." | CLAIM: This confirms the price per month for the subscription in the USA and International regions.
SOURCE: https://www.nabucasa.com/link/ | QUOTE: "The official Home Assistant subscription that gives you an easy, secure way to connect to your home from anywhere, plus so much more." | CLAIM: This defines the primary purpose of the service (remote access).
SOURCE: https://www.nabucasa.com/link/ | QUOTE: "Remote Access" | CLAIM: This confirms that remote access is included in the subscription.
SOURCE: https://www.nabucasa.com/link/ | QUOTE: "Offsite Backups" | CLAIM: This confirms that offsite backups are included in the subscription.
SOURCE: https://www.nabucasa.com/link/ | QUOTE: "Voice control (Alexa & Google Home)" | CLAIM: This confirms integration with Amazon Alexa and Google Home is included.
SOURCE: https://www.nabucasa.com/link/ | QUOTE: "Voice Processing (STT/TTS)" | CLAIM: This confirms Speech-to-Text and Text-to-Speech processing is included.
SOURCE: https://www.nabucasa.com/link/ | QUOTE: "Better media streaming (video/audio)" | CLAIM: This confirms improved media streaming capabilities are included.
SOURCE: https://www.nabucasa.com/link/ | QUOTE: "Funds the development of Home Assistant" | CLAIM: This confirms that the subscription supports the development of the software.

NO_SOURCE_FOUND: Specific hard limits regarding the number of devices, data usage caps, or number of users per subscription are not listed on the pricing or features pages.
